'''Cona''', also known as '''Arcona''', was an arid, desert world which [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Star/Legends|blue giant]] [[Teke Ro]], located in the [[Teke Ro system]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. The [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the serpent-like [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] [[Species/Legends|species]], Cona had a minimal water supply due to a geological catastrophe early in its history.

==Description==
[[File:Arcona-NEGAS.png|thumb|left|180px|An [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] native of Cona]]
Cona was a world with a lush, tropical environment. Thanks to the lack of [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] axial tilt and temperature-distributing air currents, the climate remained effectively constant across the entire planet&mdash;hot and dense. The [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] had a high concentration of [[Ammonia/Legends|ammonia]], which permeated the planet's jungles. [[Oxygen/Legends|Oxygen]] was found in Cona's bedrock, and was only brought to the surface through highly complex plant life that stored it in gastric pods. [[Water/Legends|Water]] was hard to find on Cona, and what little there was on the world was collected and stored by native plant life. The Arcona, living in small, low-tech communities on Cona, harvested the water from plant pods.<ref name="UAA" />

Because of the atmosphere's high concentration of ammonia, most non-Arcona species were forced to don [[Breath mask/Legends|breath masks]] when on the planet. While most non-native species dwelt in massive colonial cities, legends persisted that a colony of [[Duinuogwuin/Legends|Duinuogwuins]] made their home in the ammonia-filled jungles of the world.<ref name="PH" />

==History==
A low-tech world located on [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]], Cona was home to the reptilian [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] species. Discovered by scouts from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[25,000 BBY/Legends|settling of]] [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]],<ref name="TEA" /> Cona's natives were quick to venture from the world aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]] developed by other cultures to explore the greater galaxy and bring back technologies of other species to Cona. As non-Arcona began exploring Cona, entrepreneurs discovered the rich mineral resources of the world and traded mass shipments of water in exchange for mining rights. Cona swiftly became home to many of the galaxy's largest mining companies, and some smaller ones like [[Nemlor Minerals]]; the world gained a seat in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] as its importance in the mining industry increased.<ref name="UAA" />

Under the control of spin-based corporate entities throughout the weakening of the Republic during the [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]], Cona was able to grow its infrastructure significantly during this time.<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Erecting impressive starports for their guests and imposing cities around their headquarters, Cona quickly drew in many visitors hoping to reap vast wealth from the planet's minerals.<ref name="UAA" /> In [[50 BBY/Legends|50 BBY]], prospectors discovered that [[Salt/Legends|sodium chloride]] was a highly addictive hallucinogen to Arcona. Once the species was exposed to mass amounts of salt, an entire generation of salt addicts nearly crippled society on Cona. Imposing draconian laws on the planet, the Republic intervened and saved Cona from financial and social ruin with the aid of a concerned government. Despite these efforts, salt addiction remained a problem for Arcona in the following decades.<ref name="TNEGtAS" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], a salt-smuggling operation was halted by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]] after the world called upon the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for assistance.<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|55|regional/1359_2.html|Arconan Smuggling Cartel Dismantled}}</ref>

The space surrounding Cona was patrolled by the [[Fourth Outer Rim Army|4th Sector Army]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> When the war came to an end and the Republic was replaced with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Cona willingly submitted to Imperial rule. Despite their fondness of the uniformity the Empire promised, support dwindled during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and the planet eventually joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="UAA" /> When the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invaded]] the galaxy, Cona was [[Attack on Cona|attacked]] by the Yuuzhan Vong and the [[Ailon Nova Guard/Legends|Ailon Nova Guard]]. Falling to the invaders, Cona was once more liberated by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Cona in the [[Mayagil sector/Legends|Mayagil sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].
